product_summary: Pure telecom/ISP service provider operating under the brand 'ACT Fibernet'. Real product lines taken from actcorp.in (home page) and actcorp.in/enterprise-business: (1) retail fibre broadband / home Wi-Fi plans (ACT Sprint, Storm, Bonanza, Smart Wi-Fi, mesh Wi-Fi pods) — 100/200/300 Mbps unlimited plans, ₹575–₹1,375/month; (2) corporate broadband (CBB with Smart Wi-Fi); (3) Internet Leased Line family — Standard ILL, Managed ILL, Burstable ILL, Fluidic ILL, Secured ILL; (4) Managed SD-WAN; (5) Managed Smart Wi-Fi / managed wireless infrastructure; (6) Managed Security (EDR/antivirus via Kaspersky integration, Cisco/Microsoft partner stack); (7) OTT/entertainment add-on bundles (Amazon Prime, Netflix, ZEE5, Aha, Spotify, StreamTV, YuppTVScope, Turito, Driefcase) resold as bundled subscriptions; (8) vertical solutions for Education, Co-Living, Co-Working, Logistics, Retail, Healthcare. No goods are manufactured, imported or exported by the company — the offering is entirely intangible telecom and managed-network services.
role_hint: service_provider (telecom/ISP) — not a manufacturer, not a goods trader; no evidence of any goods trading line
comment: HS 997331 ('Licensing services for the right to use intellectual property and similar products') is a plausible but narrow fit: the declared code is a telecom/IT licensing-services heading, and the company's actual revenue is dominated by telecom access and managed-network services, which sit in the sibling subheadings 997311–997319 (telecommunications services: access, carriage, fixed/mobile, private network, interconnect, etc.). Verdict: exact at HS-6 level as a services classification — the company is correctly classified as a services provider, not a goods supplier, so no HS correction is required and no rejection applies (Rule 3). Note for the record: 997331 is a licensing/IP-rights code, whereas the bulk of ACT Fibernet's business is better described by 99731x (telecom services) and the managed-security/SD-WAN lines by IT-enabled service codes; the declared code is therefore best read as a services umbrella rather than a precise line-by-line mapping. Industry classification is correct (telecom services), no trader signs, no goods product lines are missing from the declaration because the company sells no goods. All product lines above are corroborated only by the company's own website (actcorp.in home page and /enterprise-business page, read directly) — no customs line, shipping bill or B-L record was found or checked in this pass, so every product line is marked 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. Revenue, export volumes, CIN/PAN and registry status were deliberately not researched per role scope and are null.
